svg.aria-label: dsh-freight-audit structure: a carrier bill CSV and a ratecard JSON feed one per-shipment ledger; each row computes expected cost from base + per-kg x weight plus fuel, records the signed variance in cents, and is split around a central zero axis (undercharge left, overcharge right); the recovery scoreboard sums over and under into a net; two R1 write gates export a dispute CSV and an xlsx workpaper, while a read-only rail holds zone_lookup, ratecard_validate and accessorial_check
svg.title: dsh-freight-audit: one signed-variance ledger, two write gates, one read-only rail
